assignment: Write a survey memo deciding what can be reported about basin snow cover this week.
source: The low zone covers 60% of area and has mean snow depth 10 cm from 12 plots. The high zone covers 40% and has mean 40 cm from three accessible plots. Two steep high-zone routes were unavailable. Last year's comparable area-weighted depth was 25 cm. No snow-density measurements were made.

criteria.full: Computes the nominal area-weighted estimate of 22 cm and distinguishes it from the unweighted plot average.
criteria.partial: Computes a mean without accounting for the 60/40 area weights.

criteria.full: Explains how missing steep high sites and only three accessible high plots affect the comparison to 25 cm.
criteria.partial: Claims a confident three-centimeter decline from the nominal estimate.

criteria.full: Distinguishes snow depth from water equivalent and identifies the missing density information.
criteria.partial: Uses centimeters of depth as water storage.

criteria.full: Proposes safe alternative observation or remote coverage of missed terrain and explicit uncertainty reporting.
criteria.partial: Suggests adding plots without targeting the missing stratum.
